## X-Sense Home Security v1.6.4

### Cloud MQTT Recovery Hotfix
- Improves recovery after repeated cloud MQTT WebSocket handshake failures by signing each reconnect attempt with current AWS credentials and refreshing credentials when repeated failures warrant it. This recovery refresh is rate-limited without throttling HTTP polling. (#434)
- Restores subscriptions after reconnect and prevents acknowledgments or timeouts from older connections from invalidating current subscriptions.
- Prevents reconnect work from reopening sockets while the integration unloads or replaces a client.

### SBS50 Security Alarms
- Exposes actual SBS50 intrusion alarms as the Home Assistant event `xsense_intrusion_triggered`, with triggering sensor details when provided. A door opening or motion detection alone does not emit this event. (#432)
